# Passing mirror fixture

Hendricks observes four systems: Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. Hendricks does not measure, test, monitor, or report on Google AI Mode or Microsoft Copilot.

Those figures describe 17 questions, three systems, one geography, and one date. It is a baseline, not evidence that any tactic works.

Seventeen questions across three engines produce 51 cells.
